cases.expected: returns the same JsonSchema instance (reference equality)
cases.description: The ValidationContext of the JsonSchema already holds ConfigSameAsContext. Calling withConfig with an equal configuration should not create a new schema but return the original object.

cases.expected: returns a new JsonSchema instance whose ValidationContext contains ConfigDifferentFromContext
cases.description: When the supplied configuration differs from the one stored in the current ValidationContext (and the meta‑schema does not force a change), withConfig must build a new ValidationContext and return a freshly constructed JsonSchema.

cases.expected: returns a new JsonSchema instance whose ValidationContext config has discriminatorKeywordEnabled=true and nullableKeywordEnabled=true
cases.description: If the meta‑schema declares the keyword "discriminator" and the supplied config has discriminatorKeywordEnabled=false, withConfig must automatically enable both the discriminator and nullable keywords (by rebuilding the config via the builder) and then create a new JsonSchema because the effective config changed.
Passing a null SchemaValidatorsConfig should cause a NullPointerException when the method tries to read config properties.

If the JsonSchema instance has a null ValidationContext (e.g., created via reflection or a faulty factory), calling withConfig will attempt to invoke getValidationContext().getMetaSchema() and result in a NullPointerException.
